description: Phase C fixup — flipping a continuing Normal-mode clip to Locked while the playhead is parked at a break must stop the cycling immediately. Same setup as section_loop_normal: 16-frame Loop clip, break at frame 8, sectionBehavior=Normal. Auto-pause fires; continuation phase advances. Then SetClipSectionBehavior=Locked while still at-break — mapToMediaFrame must stop consulting ClipPlaybackPhase and fall back to the timeline-derived path (frozen at source frame 8). Without the sectionBehavior re-check in the continuation branch, the clip would keep looping despite the toggle. CI-robustness notes: WaitUntilPlaybackState replaces the fixed pre-park WaitSeconds, and WaitUntilClipMediaFrame polls until the phase demonstrably leaves the [8±1] window — the old fixed-moment sample could land exactly when the 16-frame loop wrapped back to 7 and fail on sampling luck. The post-flip equal-mode assert keeps its settle wait: a frozen value does not race, and the wait proves the cycling STAYS stopped.
